claims.quote: The Kra stream catfish, Akysis pulvinatus, is a small akysid catfish from southern Thailand.

Described from a stream discharging into the Andaman Sea in Kapoe district, Ranong Province, southern Thailand and at time of writing is known only from a series of similar streams on the western side of the Kra Isthmus, plus the upper Tapi river basin.
